name: Feature and entry schema with configurable kinds
description:
Feature: feature, status (manual: proposed|planned|in-progress|shipped|deprecated), summary, when hints (paths, anchors, keywords), created/updated, entries.
Entry: id, kind, one-line summary (required), body (markdown literal block), when, claims, created/updated/read.
config.yaml declares kinds with behaviour (render: always|index|never, push: on-edit|on-read|when-feature-active|never, prune policy). Undeclared kinds are invalid. Default kinds: rule, fact, gotcha, howto, decision, plan.
author: cbk <cbk@snappy.no>

comments.author: cbk <cbk@snappy.no>
comments.text: Merged 1f26358. Default kinds: rule(index,on-edit), fact(never,on-read,prune 180d), gotcha(never,on-edit,365d), howto(index,never,180d), decision(never,never), plan(never,when-feature-active). No kind renders 'always'. Entry ids are kebab-case, unique per file, addressed feature/entry and repo/entry for repo.yaml. DocsValidator.Validate(snapshot) gives the #28 problem list. Timestamps: created/updated UTC to the second, read is date-only; init stamps created only. Open points: #29 must decide whether repo.yaml entries render in full regardless of kind; #31 should fall back to created when read is null; #34 assumes on-read also covers edits; all-digit hashes are written unquoted (other YAML tools may read them as numbers).
